Intro: Here's what's new since your last digest:
Footer: This is an automated message from your Jellyfin server.
EmptyDigest: Nothing new since your last digest.
AdminOutcomeAccepted: The SMTP server accepted the request. This does not guarantee the message reaches the mailbox.
AdminOutcomeInvalidRequest: The settings or the address are not valid, so nothing was sent. Check the SMTP settings and the password.
AdminOutcomeConnectionFailed: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the host, port and network.
AdminOutcomeTlsFailed: A secure connection could not be established. The server may not support the chosen encryption, or its certificate is not trusted. The connection was not continued without encryption.
AdminOutcomeAuthenticationFailed: The server rejected the username or password.
AdminOutcomeSenderRejected: The server rejected the sender address.
AdminOutcomeRecipientRejected: The server rejected the recipient address.
AdminOutcomeTimeout: The SMTP server did not answer in time.
AdminOutcomeUnexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Jellyfin log for details.
TestEmailBody: This is a test message from the Email Digest plugin, sent because an administrator asked for it. If you can read it, the SMTP server accepted it. No media information is included.
AdminIntro: Configure how digest emails are sent. Nothing is sent until digest delivery is enabled in a later release; the tests below send only what you ask for.
AdminDigestEnabledDesc: Master switch for the digest feature. No emails are sent while this is off.
AdminDefaultLanguageDesc: Used for a user who has not chosen their own digest language.
AdminLookbackDesc: How far back to look for new media on the very first run, before any checkpoint exists.
AdminSmtpEnabledDesc: Allows the plugin to send mail through the server below.
AdminUnencryptedWarning: Warning: unencrypted SMTP sends every message, including its content and recipient, in clear text, and cannot be used with a username or password. Use it only on a trusted private network.
AdminUsernameDesc: Leave empty if the server needs no login. Login requires encryption.
AdminSaveFailed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
AdminPasswordDesc: The password is write-only: it is never shown again and never sent back to this page.
AdminPasswordStatusStored: A password is set. It is stored on the server as plain text in the plugin folder, protected only by file permissions.
AdminPasswordStatusExternal: The password is provided by the server deployment (a Docker secret) and cannot be changed here.
AdminPasswordInvalid: That password is not allowed (empty, over 512 characters, or contains control characters).
AdminPasswordExternal: The password is managed by the server deployment and cannot be changed here.
AdminTestSaveFirst: Save your changes before testing. Tests use the saved settings.
AdminTestConnectionDesc: Connects and logs in. Sends no email.
AdminTestSendDesc: Sends one short message to this address only.
AdminThrottled: Please wait a few seconds before sending another test email.
AdminUnexpected: Something went wrong. Check the Jellyfin log.
AdminPasswordReenter: The SMTP server settings changed, so the stored password was removed. Enter the password again.
AdminDryRunDesc: While on, a digest run builds and checks each user's digest and logs counts, but sends nothing and records nothing. Turn it off only when you are ready for real emails.
AdminMaxPerSectionDesc: Items beyond this are not lost: they appear in the user's next digest.
AdminMaxEpisodesDesc: The series line still shows how many new episodes there are.
AdminLibrariesDesc: Choose which libraries are included in digests and which section each appears under. A new library is never included until you tick it here. Each user still only sees what Jellyfin lets them see.
AdminLibrariesEmptyNote: With nothing ticked, no digest contains anything.
AdminLibraryMissing: No longer exists in Jellyfin. It is dropped when you save.
ContinuationNote: Items that did not fit are not lost: they will be included in your next digest.
AdminOutcomeUncertain: The connection failed while the message was being sent, so it is not known whether the server accepted it. Check your mailbox before trying again.
AdminStatusModeDisabled: The digest is disabled. Nothing will be sent.
AdminStatusModeDryRun: Dry run: digests are built and checked, but nothing is sent.
AdminStatusModeLive: Live: digests are sent by email.
AdminStatusNoRun: No run has been recorded yet.
AdminStatusCounts: Evaluated {0}, skipped {1}, accepted {2}, failed {3} ({4} uncertain), no new media {5}, dry-run digests {6}, not attempted {7}.
AdminReasonAlreadyRunning: Another run was already in progress.
AdminReasonConfigurationUnreadable: The configuration could not be read.
AdminReasonConfigurationInvalid: The configuration is invalid. Review the settings.
AdminReasonLibrariesInvalid: A monitored library no longer exists. Review the monitored libraries.
AdminReasonLibrariesUnverifiable: The monitored libraries could not be verified against Jellyfin.
AdminReasonSmtpPasswordMissing: A username is set but there is no SMTP password.
AdminReasonStateUnreadable: The delivery state file cannot be trusted. See the documentation to recover it.
AdminReasonSmtpUnusable: The mail server refused the login, the secure connection or the sender, so the run stopped.
AdminReasonStateWriteFailed: A delivery was accepted but could not be recorded, so the run stopped. A duplicate is likely next time.
AdminReasonUserFailures: Some users could not be delivered to. Check the log.
AdminReasonUnexpectedError: An unexpected error stopped the run. Check the log.
VerifyIntro: Someone asked to use this email address for notifications from {0}.
VerifyAction: To confirm that this address is yours, open this link:
VerifyExpires: The link works once and expires on {0} UTC.
VerifyIgnore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message. Nothing will be sent to this address and nothing will change.
VerifyFooter: This is an automated message. It contains no information about any media.
AdminReasonPublicUrlMissing: The public server address is not set, so a digest cannot carry its unsubscribe link. Set it in the settings.
AdminReasonPreferencesUnreadable: The user preferences file cannot be trusted. See the documentation to recover it.
AdminReasonUnsubscribeUnavailable: The unsubscribe key cannot be used, so nothing was sent. See the documentation.
UserIntro: Choose whether you get an email with what is new on this server, in which language, and where it is sent.
UserSignInRequired: Sign in to Jellyfin in this browser, then open this page again.
UserLoadError: Your preferences could not be loaded. Try again later.
UserForbidden: Your account cannot use this page.
UserNotificationsLabel: Send me email digests of new media
UserNotificationsOff: Digests are off. You will not receive any email.
UserNotificationsNeedAddress: Digests are on, but nothing is sent until you confirm an email address below.
UserDigestsNotActive: The administrator has not switched on sending yet, so no digests are being sent for now.
UserAddressUnverified: Address on file: {0}. It is not confirmed, so nothing is sent to it until you confirm an address.
UserAddressPending: Waiting for confirmation: {0}. A link was sent to that address; it works once and expires on {1}. Until you open it, digests keep going to the address in use.
UserAddressUnavailable: Changing the address is not available right now. Ask the administrator.
UserAddressSent: Confirmation email sent. Open the link in it to finish.
UserAddressSentUncertain: The mail server did not clearly confirm sending. If the email does not arrive, try again in a few minutes.
UserErrInvalidAddress: That is not a valid email address.
UserErrRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {0} seconds.
UserErrSendFailed: The confirmation email could not be sent. Try again later.
UserStatusLastAccepted: Last digest accepted by the mail server: {0}
UserStatusNever: No digest has been accepted yet.
UserStatusFailed: failed; it will be tried again at the next run
UserStatusUncertain: uncertain; it may or may not have been sent
UserStatusNextRun: Next scheduled run: {0}. A run sends an email only if something is new for you.
UserStatusNextUnknown: The time of the next run is not known.
UserStatusDisclaimer: "Accepted" means the mail server took the message. It does not guarantee that it reached your inbox; check your spam folder.
UserHelp: Turning digests off here stops the emails. It does not delete your Jellyfin account or anything else.
LinkVerifyText: Press the button to confirm that this address is yours and may receive your Jellyfin digests.
LinkVerifyDone: Your address is confirmed. Digests will go to it whenever you have them turned on.
LinkVerifyInvalid: This link no longer works. It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer one. Ask for a new link in your preferences.
LinkVerifyNotApplied: The address could not be saved. Ask for a new link in your preferences.
LinkUnsubscribeText: Press the button to stop receiving digest emails from this server. Your account is not affected.
LinkUnsubscribeDone: Done. You will not receive digest emails. You can turn them on again in your preferences after signing in to Jellyfin.
LinkUnsubscribeInvalid: This link is not valid. Use the link in your most recent digest, or turn the emails off in your preferences.
LinkError: Something went wrong. Try again later.
LinkNoToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
AdminPublicUrlDesc: The address people use to reach this server from outside, for example https://jellyfin.example.org (add the sub-path if the server runs under one). Links in emails are built from it and nothing else. Required to confirm email addresses and to send real digests.
AdminPublicUrlMissing: No public server address is set: users cannot confirm email addresses and real digests will not be sent.
AdminPublicUrlInsecure: This address uses http, so the one-time links in emails travel unencrypted. Use https if you can.
AdminVerifyMinutesDesc: How long the link in a confirmation email works, from 5 to 1440 minutes. Each link works once.
AdminStatusSubscribers: People with preferences: {0}. Digests on: {1}. Will receive digests: {2}. Waiting for a confirmed address: {3}.
AdminStatusPreferencesProblem: The user preferences file cannot be trusted, so nothing is sent. See the documentation to recover it.
